form.label: CCDC | VyOS Router
form.description: VyOS 1.4.0. Requires router syslog forwarded to Splunk or a syslog collector; no promise of automatic collection.

search.query: index=* (sourcetype=ccdc:vyos_syslog OR host=vyos*) | stats count by host,source,sourcetype | sort -count
index=* (sourcetype=ccdc:vyos_syslog OR host=vyos*) ("sudo" OR "login" OR "authentication" OR "commit" OR "configure") | table _time host source _raw | sort -_time
index=* (sourcetype=ccdc:vyos_syslog OR host=vyos*) ("firewall" OR "route" OR "DROP" OR "REJECT") | table _time host source _raw | sort -_time
